concepts.definition: comprehensive verification process covering stock levels, expiration dates, and storage conditions before operations begin
confirmation that current inventory quantities match expected levels using scanning technology
validation that minimum stock thresholds are appropriately set and maintained
systematic check of all perishable items to identify and remove expired or soon-to-expire products
physical examination of all food storage locations for compliance, organization, and safety standards
automated notification system for low stock levels and approaching expiration dates
monitoring and logging of all food items from receipt through usage
systematic documentation of all inventory transactions, inspections, and compliance activities
formal documentation of health inspection findings and compliance status
standardized classification system for health code infractions requiring remediation
